hero.subheadline: From hand-coded websites to internal dashboards, automation, and AI tools, we design and build digital products that actually work for your business.

whatWeDo.label: What we do
whatWeDo.heading: Two kinds of work, one standard.
whatWeDo.description: Whatever your business needs, it gets built to actually work. We keep it to two simple ideas.

buckets.title: Websites
buckets.description: Your public face. Marketing sites, landing pages, and rich, motion-driven experiences. Every site is hand-coded, loads fast, and looks right on every device.

buckets.title: Software & Tools
buckets.description: Things that run and do work. Internal systems, automation, dashboards, AI features, and full apps. Built to your spec, from the ground up, to solve a real workflow problem.

work.label: Our work
work.heading: Real results for real businesses.
work.description: Every project here started with a real problem. Here is how we solved it.

process.heading: We show you, then we build it.

steps.title: Understand the need
steps.description: We start with a real conversation about your business, not a form to fill out.

steps.title: Build a working demo
steps.description: We put together a real, working version you can actually click through.

steps.title: You see it, then we refine

steps.title: Ship and keep improving

about.label: About us
about.heading: Small studio. No shortcuts.
about.paragraph1: Bonsai Digital is run by an engineer with a Toyota background and American roots, based in Tokyo. We build websites, web applications, internal tools, and AI systems. Everything from scratch, because that is the only way to do it right.
about.paragraph2: Whatever you are building, you work directly with the person building it. No account managers, no ticket systems. Just clear communication in Japanese or English, and work that holds up.

values.title: Speed
values.description: We move quickly without cutting corners. You will have something real to review in days.

values.title: Quality
values.description: Every pixel and every line of code is intentional. We write from scratch because that is the only way to do it right.

values.title: User experience
values.description: We design for the people who will actually use it. How something feels to use matters more than how it looks.

values.title: Collaboration
values.description: You work directly with the person building it. No account managers, no handoffs, no context lost.

values.title: Attention to detail
values.description: Nothing is too small to get right. The details you cannot quite articulate are usually the ones that matter most.

values.title: Long-term partnership
values.description: We do not build and disappear. From launch through growth, we stay close and scale with you.

contact.label: Get in touch

definex.title: DefineX
definex.description: A platform that teaches athletes in Japan English, providing all the resources they need to play abroad.
definex.overview: DefineX is a platform dedicated to helping Japanese athletes build English skills. It offers structured courses, learning resources, and ongoing support so athletes have everything they need to pursue opportunities overseas. We partnered with DefineX to build a digital presence that matches their ambitious mission.

showcase.title: Landing Page Redesign
showcase.description: Crafted a modern, conversion-focused landing page that communicates DefineX's mission clearly to athletes and parents.

showcase.title: Academy Page Development
showcase.description: Built a comprehensive academy section showcasing courses, instructors, and learning paths for athletes at every level.

showcase.title: Payment Integration
showcase.description: Implemented secure payment processing with tiered pricing plans for course enrollments and subscriptions.

showcase.title: Email Contact System
showcase.description: Set up a reliable contact system for inquiries, free trial requests, and automated communications.

cgOnlineAcademy.title: CG Online Academy
cgOnlineAcademy.description: A full redesign of a professional 3D artist's online presence, complete with live Three.js model rendering and an integrated course platform with video lessons and progress tracking.
cgOnlineAcademy.overview: CG Online Academy is the revamped digital home for a professional 3D artist and educator. The old site lacked the visual impact needed to reflect the quality of the work being taught. We rebuilt it from the ground up with a modern UI, interactive Three.js model rendering that brings the artist's characters to life in the browser, and a full course platform where students can purchase and follow video lessons with step-by-step guides. Progress tracking keeps everyone on track.

transformation.heading: The Transformation
transformation.description: The client came to us with a website that no longer represented their skill level. The old site was outdated, hard to navigate, and wasn't converting visitors into students. We started by auditing what wasn't working, then rebuilt every page from scratch while keeping the brand identity intact.

showcase.title: Complete UI/UX Redesign
showcase.description: Transformed the CG Online website from scratch. Modernized the visual language, improved information hierarchy, and built a fluid, responsive layout that reflects the quality of the artist's work.

showcase.title: Live 3D Model Viewer with Three.js
showcase.description: Integrated Three.js to render the artist's actual 3D character models directly in the browser. Visitors can interact with real-time rendered models, showcasing the depth of the artist's craft in a way static images never could.

showcase.title: Course Platform with Progress Tracking
showcase.description: Built a full course system where students who purchase a course can access video lessons and written guides directly on the site. Progress is saved per user so they can pick up exactly where they left off.

showcase.title: Student Work Gallery
showcase.description: Dedicated gallery showcasing work produced by students following the courses. It acts as social proof and demonstrates the real-world results of the curriculum.

chnl301.title: Chnl301
chnl301.description: A band website built to give Chnl301 a proper home on the internet, one that captures their sound, their aesthetic, and their story.
chnl301.overview: Chnl301 came to us with a clear vision: they wanted a website that didn't just list their music, but actually felt like them. The brief was to build something with a specific theme and atmosphere that fans would recognize as unmistakably Chnl301. We took that direction seriously, designing and developing every element of the site around their identity, from the visual language and layout to the way their content is presented.

showcase.title: Landing Page & Visual Identity
showcase.description: Designed a landing page that immediately communicates the band's character. From the typography and colour palette to the layout and imagery, every decision was driven by the band's aesthetic direction.

showcase.title: Music & Video Section
showcase.description: Built a dedicated space for the band's music and video content, giving fans an easy way to discover and explore their releases without leaving the site.

showcase.title: Artist Profiles
showcase.description: Each member of the band gets their own spotlight, introducing the people behind the music and deepening the connection between the band and their audience.

homeHairCoffee.title: Home Hair & Coffee Roaster
homeHairCoffee.description: A website for Home Hair & Coffee Roaster, a hair salon and coffee roasting shop in Sanuki, Kagawa.
homeHairCoffee.overview: Home Hair & Coffee Roaster is a unique dual-concept shop in Shido, Sanuki, Kagawa. One side is a relaxed hair salon, the other is a small-batch coffee roasting operation called ARMS Coffee. They needed a site that could present both sides of the business clearly without one overshadowing the other. We designed and built a bilingual website that gives each side its own space while keeping the whole thing feeling cohesive and welcoming.

showcase.title: Hair Salon Section
showcase.description: A clean layout presenting the salon's menu, pricing, and a photography grid that captures the atmosphere of the space. The design keeps things simple and approachable, letting the work speak for itself.

showcase.title: ARMS Coffee Section
showcase.description: A dedicated section for the coffee roasting side of the business, telling the story behind ARMS Coffee with a photo gallery showcasing the beans, the process, and the shop itself.

showcase.title: Shop Info & Contact
showcase.description: All the essential details in one place: location, hours, access, and contact info. Features an illustrated portrait of the owner that adds a personal, handcrafted touch to the page.

bookACall.heading: Start your project.
bookACall.description: Book a free 30-minute call. We will figure out exactly what you need and the best way to get there.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: Every project is different, so we do not publish fixed prices. The best way to get an accurate number is a short call. Most websites start around ¥200,000 to ¥600,000 depending on scope. Software projects and AI systems vary more widely based on complexity.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: A straightforward website typically takes two to four weeks. More complex platforms or apps take longer, but we move fast and you will see real progress quickly. We usually have something working for you to review within the first week.

items.question: Do I need to be in Japan to work with you?
items.answer: Not at all. We work with clients across Japan and internationally. Everything runs smoothly over video calls and async communication in Japanese or English.

items.question: Can you handle both design and development?
items.answer: Yes, both. We design and build everything ourselves, so there is no coordination overhead between a designer and a developer. You get one person who owns the full picture.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: We stick around. We offer ongoing maintenance, updates, and support. Most clients work with us as a long-term technical partner rather than a one-time vendor.

items.question: Is there a free consultation?
items.answer: Yes. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute call to understand your situation and figure out the best path forward. No pressure, no obligation.
